title: Araññe
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Araññe viharantānaṃ || santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ || ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ || kena vaṇṇo pasīdatīti || || Atītaṃ nānusocanti || nappajappanti nāgataṃ || paccuppannena yāpenti || tena vaṇṇo pasīdati || || anāgatappajappāya || atītassānusocanā || etena bālā sussanti || naḷo va harito luto ti || || Naḷavaggo pathamo || Tatr-uddānaṃ || Ogham Nimokkho Upaneyyaṃ || Accenti Katichindi ca || Jāgaram Appaṭividitā || Susammutthā Māna-kāminā || Araññe dasamo vutto || vaggo tena pavuccati || || CHAPTER II. NANDANA-VAGGA.
